svg.text: Q3: ONE fillet of radius 5 on the 4 wide top face of a 4 x 10 x 6 box
the far edge of the face is the pivot: the arc stays tangent to the wall and passes through it
A. pivot at the far edge (CHOSEN)
tangent to the left wall, through the far edge of
the top face. Continuous: r = 4 is tangent to both,
r = 4.5, 5, 6 pivot at the same edge.
IsDone false for any r > w.
the largest radius that fits both faces. Returns
a different radius from the one asked for.
